presets.label: Product Promotion Video
required_brief: usable product reference or an explicitly fictional product concept
supported selling point and approved CTA
requested duration, aspect ratio and output language
presets.guidance: Keep the product, selling point and CTA consistent. Do not invent prices, offers, certifications or product features. Let the server select its supported execution path.

presets.label: UGC Product Video
required_brief: product references or an explicitly fictional concept
presenter style and any supplied authorized presenter reference
presets.guidance: For a fictional presenter, do not present the performance as a real customer testimonial. Do not promise a specific person, cloned voice or presenter continuity unless the backend supports and returns that result.

presets.label: Product Close-Up Video
required_brief: product references or an explicitly fictional concept
presets.guidance: Describe the intended camera movement, focus and lighting. Preserve factual shape/material claims. A turntable concept does not establish a measured 360-degree reconstruction.
